title: Weed Golf Club
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Weed Golf Club has been around since the 1920s and has been getting better and better ever since. Visitors to our area are invited to play this beautiful nine-hole course (it plays 18). If you like challenging golf shots, you will love the Weed Golf Course. Rental carts are available.
